title: A rationally rigid elliptic detector plus finite critical-value avoidance smooths affine zero sets

statement.quantifiers: Every nonconstant f in Q[X1..Xn], degree d>=1; an effective algorithm selects a positive integer m.
statement.assertion: H:Z−Z^3=m²f² is smooth geometrically integral affine, degree max(3,2d), and H(Q)=V(f)(Q) times {−1,0,1}.
assumptions: Characteristic zero; classical exact rational points of T²=Z−Z³.
Nonconstant f; constant preprocessing preserves solvability only.
Finiteness of polynomial critical values and exact Jacobian-ideal unit test.

inputs: Exact rational polynomial f, exact rational arithmetic/Groebner computation.
outputs: One-extra-variable rational-point detector, geometrically integral equation and terminating smoothness selection.
interface.precision: Exact algebraic statement over Qbar and exact rational-point equality; not a numerical approximation.
costs: No polynomial bound on m, arithmetic bits or Groebner run time provided.
Degree-eight undecidability additionally imports unverified family004 H10(Q); it is not part of this unconditional reduction.
Primary external texts not supplied; prior art/novelty need exact specialist review.

proof_mechanism: Fermat congruent-number1 obstruction forces T0 and three rational Z values.
A rational root of the monic cubic would restrict to a nonconstant P1-to-elliptic map, impossible by Riemann–Hurwitz; Gauss gives absolute irreducibility.
Any singular point projects to a nonzero critical value c of f with m²c²=±2/(3sqrt3).
Finite critical values leave finitely many bad m; enumerate and test Jacobian ideal equals1.
obstructions: k(X) over k(f) need not be regular; f=X² defeats that shortcut.
Naive projective closure adds a rational boundary point for every input and is singular there for d>=3.
Integral-point smoothing and rational-point smoothing are distinct interfaces.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Control all boundary/exceptional rational points and smoothness/integrality effectively; ordinary homogenization fails.

review.source_reported: Source written derivation and exact scopes reported; no source diagnostic code supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
